name: bdf_get_french_indicator
description:
A French economic indicator: fr_cpi (HICP inflation, annual rate of change in percent, monthly; HICP.M.FR.N.000000.4D0.ANR), fr_gdp (GDP at current prices, EUR millions, quarterly; MNA) or fr_unemployment (unemployment rate in percent, ages 15-74, seasonally adjusted, monthly; LFSI).
Returns: series_code (ECB flow.key), series_id, label, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): indicator (fr_cpi, fr_gdp, fr_unemployment; default fr_cpi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
For the euro area aggregates use bdf_get_eurozone_indicator.
Example: {"indicator": "fr_unemployment", "recent_periods": 12}
